Not yet. Right now you've verified 1 of 14 checks, and "integration-tests green" doesn't cover the other 13. *(fact)* Lint, format and freshness-style checks fail independently of the test job. I can't query the PR from this session, so I can't tell you what the other 13 say.

Run this in the repo, then you'll know:

```bash
gh auth switch -u <work-account> && gh pr checks 482 --json name,bucket,state
gh pr view 482 --json state,headRefOid,mergeable,mergeStateStatus,reviewDecision,baseRefName
git rev-parse HEAD
```

You can say "good to merge" if all of these hold:
- Every one of the 14 checks has bucket `pass`. None are `fail`, `pending` or `cancel`, and any `skipping` is one you expect.
- `headRefOid` equals your local `git rev-parse HEAD`. Otherwise the checks may belong to an older push.
- `mergeStateStatus` isn't `DIRTY` or `CONFLICTING`. If it is, no new workflow runs fire on `pull_request`.
- `reviewDecision` isn't `CHANGES_REQUESTED`, and no new review has landed since your last push.
- `baseRefName` is the branch you intended. A retargeted base changes which checks run.

If you also want to run the repo's linter locally before standup, do that first. Passing tests don't imply passing lint. *(heuristic)*

If you can't check before standup, say "integration-tests are green (96/96), the remaining checks are still being verified." That's accurate without overclaiming.

---

**Коротко, по-русски:**

Ты спросил, можно ли на стендапе сказать, что PR #482 (retry-обёртка для payments-клиента) готов к мёрджу. Пока нет: ты проверил только одну проверку из 14 (`integration-tests`, 96 тестов). Остальные 13, например линт и форматирование, могут быть красными независимо от тестов. Выше я дал три команды `gh` (GitHub CLI, консольный клиент GitHub). Они покажут статус всех проверок, совпадает ли запушенный коммит с локальным, нет ли конфликтов и новых ревью, и в ту ли ветку смотрит PR. Если проверить до стендапа не успеваешь, скажи команде, что интеграционные тесты зелёные, а остальное ещё проверяется.
